_comment: Azure AD OIDC broker template. Security & Access Mesh spec Part 2.1. Provision per-tenant via: scripts/setup-keycloak-realm.sh --idp-config /path/to/azure-ad.json. Cardinal Rule 1.3: the 'config.clientId' / 'config.clientSecret' placeholders are filled in at provisioning time from a secrets manager — NEVER commit real secrets to git.

mappers._comment: Pass through Azure AD group Object IDs verbatim — Cardinal Rule 7.4: do NOT translate to Keycloak roles; resolution happens at the database plane via security.identity_profile_mappings.
mappers.name: azure-ad-groups-pass-through
